subject.title: feat(macos): visible-markdown copy, full-message reader, and independent reasoning/tool toggles

question: After the reader preserves the current display options and macOS proof is supplied, should the new shared chat UI API and persisted preference migration be accepted as the supported native/web-alignment direction?
rationale: The patch adds a user-facing native capability, public shared-UI surface, and persistent preference migration; code review can identify the defect but cannot choose the long-term product and compatibility contract.

options.title: Sponsor the compatibility path
options.body: Accept the separate display-option API and two-key migration after the reader fix, focused regression coverage, and macOS proof are provided.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Keep the macOS behavior but reduce or redesign the shared public API before accepting a new cross-host display-options contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the compatibility path
recommendation.body: Accept the separate display-option API and two-key migration after the reader fix, focused regression coverage, and macOS proof are provided.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR history shows this contributor owns the proposed implementation details, while final product acceptance remains a maintainer decision.
